prompt: Challenge C061-CH1: Our cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil goes rancid within 4 months on shelf, but competitors manage 9–12 months; we lose about 15% of each batch

content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Cold-pressed seed oils show variable tocopherol content between cultivars that can reach 68 mg/100 g, and tocopherol levels are a key natural antioxidant system affecting oxidative stability.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-01692","field":"abstract","quote":"Tocopherol content measured by HPLC-FLD varied significantly between cultivars with NS-H3 yielding the highest γ-tocopherol"}]},{"text":"Peroxide value development during shelf-life can be modelled kinetically using accelerated testing methods to identify oxidation rate parameters and predict stability timeframes.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-01696","field":"keywords","quote":"Accelerated shelf-life testing Arrhenius model peroxide value"}]},{"text":"Lipid oxidation in seed oils proceeds through both primary oxidation (peroxide formation) and secondary oxidation (TBARS), and water activity and pH are critical environmental drivers of oxidation pathways.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-01700","field":"abstract","quote":"Peroxide values in the beverage increased from 0.9 to 3.4 mEq O₂/kg fat by day 28"}]}],"fit":"partial","fitReason":"The researcher has documented tocopherol profiling and peroxide value kinetics in cold-pressed seed oils [SYN-PUB-01692, SYN-PUB-01696] and possesses a Rancimat unit for accelerated oxidation testing, which directly addresses the challenge's need to identify oxidation pathways without major equipment investment, but the published work focuses on encapsulated systems rather than headspace oxygen control or in-bottle oxidation mechanisms."}
